skills.skill: Add whole numbers with sums up to 10 000
Subtract whole numbers within 10 000, with regrouping

misconceptions.pattern: Mishandles borrowing across zeros in multi-digit subtraction (e.g. 8002 − 3457), borrowing from a zero column without carrying the borrow onward.

strategies.intent: Line the numbers up by place value and regroup one column at a time, writing the new values above each column so a borrow across a zero is carried all the way.
